kappa.best_first_width: (novelty bucket precision 2 within #g partition, unachieved goal count, depth, generation serial); unpruned; duplicates = generated set
kappa.best_first_add_w3: frozen ChoiceFrontierController heap head (g + 3 h_add, serial)

contract.goal_test: at selection for all four algorithms (declared deviation from native BFWS goal-at-generation)
contract.budget: decision cap = expansion cap = 2 x R_t
contract.node_observation: state only in every observation type; no depth, serial, score, novelty, membership or history (author decision)

reuse.additive_visual_controls: recomputed under the v7 contract; equality with outputs/choice-frontier/v4/panels/<panel>/zoo checked

native_prefix.bfs: exact node-choice expansion sequence == bfs_pilot.exact_fifo_bfs expanded_state_ids
native_prefix.best_first_width: bfws_episode.run_best_first_width expansion sequence is a prefix (truncated corpus episodes: compared to the shorter length)

gates.identity: per algorithm and observation: seed-17 random_valid vs exact_reference expanded-state sequences on pooled panel tasks; CHOICE_SENSITIVE iff >= 1 non-trivial (menu >= 2 somewhere in exact) task diverges, else ZERO_DECISION_HEADROOM (reported, no re-run)

panels.r_t: bfs/best_first_width: uncapped exact node-choice expansions (no overflow rule); additive: frozen #139 values

corpus.walk_order: non-excluded rows in file order (#136 seed-major walk)
corpus.teacher: uncapped exact_reference node-choice episode from PDDL
corpus.additive_overflow_rule: a #136 record whose multimodal observation overflows is dropped from both additive text/multimodal cells and counted; no replacement
corpus.augmentation_check: target-is-last share within +-5 pp of mean(1/menu size)

smoke_gate.cells: every new (algorithm, observation) cell at seed 17 (10 cells)
smoke_gate.measure: accepted calls / model calls over the 3 episodes
smoke_gate.fail_rule: the cell's learned evaluation is gated out for all three seeds; verdict SMOKE_FAIL

evaluation.learned: 30 new cells x 23 pooled tasks, greedy, inference seed 17
evaluation.zero_shot_base: 12 cells x 23 tasks, one realisation (seed 17), cap 2 x R_t, #141 extractor re-applied at replay

zero_shot_suffix.visual: Reply with exactly one JSON object and nothing else, of the form {"expand_choice": "<label>"}, where <label> is one of the frontier_menu choices (c0, c1, ...). Choose the frontier state whose scene appears closest to satisfying the goal pages.
zero_shot_suffix.text: Reply with exactly one JSON object and nothing else, of the form {"expand_choice": "<label>"}, where <label> is one of the frontier_menu choices (c0, c1, ...). Choose the frontier state whose facts appear closest to satisfying the goal constraints.
zero_shot_suffix.multimodal: Reply with exactly one JSON object and nothing else, of the form {"expand_choice": "<label>"}, where <label> is one of the frontier_menu choices (c0, c1, ...). Choose the frontier state whose scene and facts appear closest to satisfying the goal constraints and pages.

evaluation.replay: every episode independently replayed; 0 mismatch; complete coverage or explicit missingness

analysis.primary: per (algorithm, observation) cell on the pooled 23 tasks: D3 = mean_s M1(learned, s) - M1(random_valid 5-seed mean); #138 verdict rule delta 0.05; Holm over 12 cells alpha 0.05 with one-sided bootstrap p
secondary: text/image split contrasts on learned M1 and on D3, per algorithm and pooled
analysis.sensitivity: exclude (task, algorithm) pairs where exact_reference overflows under any observation type
